purpose: repair temp-only direct bridge outputs into expected notifier final-message filenames while publishing only status receipts
operating_rules: input and copy scope is temp-only lane output folders
explicit Lane=filename source mappings are supported
raw lane text is never written into repo receipts
hashes, byte counts, lane names, marker counts, and statuses are safe to publish
existing expected final-message files are not overwritten unless explicitly requested
strict sensitive/path markers block automatic repair and force review
why_it_matters: v499 v7 x1 proved the direct bridge can succeed even when the strict helper fails before wrapper sentinels; this helper makes that recovery repeatable and auditable.
